contract: Worker A companion rationale metadata for canonical AffectedTestMapping records; the Worker B v1 schema remains unchanged.

mappings.reason: P1 trust, policy, manifest, audit, threat-model, IPC, tests, or durable evidence changes require the complete P1 exit gate.
Native authority, cross-language trust, P1A toolchain, platform, or durable evidence changes require the P1A exit gate.
Owner Mode runtime, automation host, product tests, source contracts, workflows, or evidence changes select all dependency-safe P2 source and lifecycle checks.
Behavioral runner, cleanup/finalization, platform receipt, aggregate manifest, or controlled workflow changes require the distinct behavioral-closure gate.
Worker A registry, adapter, evidence-pack, historical compatibility, or progress changes require both canonical shared checks and the Worker A integration check.
